description: This file defines a Java class 'LoanReAgingCommandHandler' that handles re-aging commands for loan accounts within the Fineract platform. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and contains logic to invoke the 'LoanReAgingServiceImpl' service to perform the re-aging operation, with error handling for data integrity violations and system exceptions.

classes.name: LoanReAgingCommandHandler
classes.description: A service component that handles re-aging commands for loan accounts, executing the re-aging logic and managing associated error handling.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a re-aging command by invoking the re-aging service and handling potential data integrity or system exceptions.
